paragraphs:
**HI, MY NAME IS KAT!**
I'm your private tour guide in the Riviera Maya and Yucatan, specializing in personalized adventures for families, couples, groups of friends and corporate teams.

Whether you're a nature lover, a history enthusiast, an adventurous soul, or simply looking for a different way to experience Mexico, I have a tour for you. And if you don't see the perfect combination of places and activities on my list, no problem. Let's create your adventure together.

Originally from Estonia, I was temporarily adopted by the USA and then Australia before eventually finding my way to Mexico. After traveling around the US, Europe, Asia and Australia, I came to Mexico for a vacation... and never left.
I fell in love with its breathtaking beaches and cenotes, its rich culture and history, and most importantly, its vibrant people. It's been 13 years now, and I've never looked back.

I feel very fortunate to be able to share the colors of Mexico with my guests, and there is so much to see. I can take you into the jungle to search for wild monkeys, plunge into the crystal-clear waters of a cenote, explore the mysteries of the Maya civilization and colorful colonial cities, or snorkel with whale sharks and sea turtles. I'll share with you stories of Maya life and Mexican culture, you'll find out how the cenotes were formed and why the sea animals are so amazing!
I'm meticulous about providing the best service while showing you the hidden gems of the Riviera Maya and the Yucatan Peninsula.
I'm a certified tour guide, which means I'm authorized to guide inside Mexico's archaeological sites under the regulations of the National Institute of Anthropology and History (INAH).

I have 13 years of experience guiding snorkeling tours, and I'll make sure you enjoy your time in the water, even if it's your first time snorkeling. I regularly renew my Red Cross First Aid certification.
I'm also an amateur diver and freediver (PADI Open Water / AIDA 2).
I'm an amateur photographer, too, and I'm more than happy to help you with pictures during our adventure. After all, someone has to prove you really swam in that cenote.
So, what would you like to see?

tours.title: Choose your day
tours.subtitle: Every tour is private - just your group, your pace, your way. Pick what calls to you, or message me and we'll build something custom.

services.title: Everything you need, taken care of
services.subtitle: From the moment you land to the moment you're back at your hotel - here's what I do beyond the standard tours.

private.title: 100% private, always
private.body: No strangers, no shared vans, no waiting for people you've never met. Every experience is exclusively your group - family, friends, partners. We move when you're ready.

transport.title: Door-to-door transport
transport.body: I pick you up and drop you off at your hotel or resort in Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Puerto Aventuras, or Akumal. Air-conditioned comfort the whole way - no taxis to figure out.

languages.title: Guided in your language
languages.body: English, Spanish, Russian - fluently, not conversationally. If your group speaks a mix, everyone gets the full experience. No one gets the short version.

custom.title: Built around you
custom.body: Mix a cenote swim with a ruin visit. Add wildlife time. Skip what doesn't excite you. Tell me what your perfect day looks like and I'll make it happen.

q1.question: How far in advance should I book?
q1.answer: At least a week ahead is ideal, especially December through April when the Riviera Maya is at its busiest. That said, if I have availability, I'll always try to make last-minute work - just message me.

q2.question: Do you provide snorkeling gear?
q2.answer: Yes - masks, fins, and life jackets for everyone in your group, all included. You don't need to bring or rent anything.

q3.question: Can you pick us up from our resort?
q3.answer: Absolutely. I pick up from Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Puerto Aventuras, and Akumal at no extra charge. Cancún pickups are possible too - just ask and I'll let you know if there's a small transport fee.

q4.question: We're traveling with young kids - is that okay?
q4.answer: Completely. Some of my favorite tours are with families. I know which cenotes are calm and shallow for little ones, and I'll make sure the pace works for everyone. Just tell me the ages and I'll recommend the right experience.

q5.question: Can we build a custom tour?
q5.answer: Yes, and it's honestly my favorite thing to do. Tell me what excites your group - ruins, cenotes, wildlife, food, all of the above - and I'll design a day around exactly that.

q6.question: Is lunch included?
q6.answer: It depends on the tour - some include a local meal, others don't. Either way, I always know the best spots nearby and I'll point you in the right direction. You won't eat at a tourist trap on my watch.

about.title: Hi, I'm Kat
about.intro: I came to the Riviera Maya for a summer. That was 8 years ago. I fell in love with the cenotes, the ruins, the jungle, the people - and I never left. These days I spend my time taking small groups of travelers to the places I love most, the way I'd show them to a close friend.
about.whyBody: Most tours are designed for efficiency - get people in, move them through, get them out. I've always wanted the opposite. I want you to leave feeling like you actually saw something real. Like you touched the wall of a ruin and thought about who built it. Like you floated in a cenote and forgot, for a minute, that the rest of the world existed.
about.experienceBody: Eight years of guiding in English, Spanish, and Russian. Deep knowledge of Mayan archaeology, local ecology, and the hidden corners of the Riviera Maya most visitors never find. I'm a certified guide - but more than that, I'm someone who genuinely loves this place and wants you to love it too.
about.promiseBody: You will never feel rushed. You will never be just a number. Every tour I lead is shaped around your group's pace, energy, and curiosity. Some of my guests come for adventure. Some come for history. Some just want to float in beautiful water and not think about anything. All of that is valid. All of that is possible. This is your day - I'm here to make it unforgettable.

contact.title: Let's start planning
contact.subtitle: Tell me when you're arriving, who you're traveling with, and what sounds exciting. I'll take it from there.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: The fastest way to reach me. I reply within the hour most days - sometimes faster. If you're not sure where to start, just say hello.

email.title: Email
email.body: Prefer to write it all out? I check daily and respond within 24 hours.

hours.title: Response time
hours.body: I'm usually available 8am-8pm Mexico time (GMT-5). If I'm out on a tour, I'll reply as soon as I'm back.
